# Third-party baseline sources

The Falcon files in this directory are copied from the local Falcon Round 3
AVX2 implementation used by the original experiment. In particular,
`bench_matvec_falcon_native.c` is retained as the complete Falcon-native
baseline, together with the Falcon core files it links against.

Before external publication, copy the upstream Falcon license and attribution
files into this directory and record the exact upstream revision. This source
is not relicensed by the Apache-2.0 license in the project root.
